name: meshy
description: Generate 3D models from text or images with Meshy, add PBR textures, and download them for games, animation, AR and 3D printing. In hosts with a terminal, also rig, animate, remesh and prepare print files.

interface.longDescription:
Meshy 3D is an AI 3D model generator for ChatGPT and Codex. Turn text, photos or sketches into 3D assets for games, animation, AR and 3D printing, usually in about a minute.

Create models with text to 3D and image to 3D, starting from an AI reference picture when the look is not settled yet. Make game-ready props and characters with low-poly topology and a target polygon count. Generate PBR textures from a prompt or a reference image, for new models and for models you already have. Follow progress and preview the result in the conversation, browse your model library in the Meshy 3D app, and download GLB, FBX, OBJ, USDZ or STL.

In Codex and other hosts with a terminal, Meshy 3D goes further by running the Meshy CLI on your computer. Rig humanoid characters, add animations and generate motion clips from text. Remesh models, build LODs, unwrap UVs and convert formats. Prepare models for 3D printing with printability checks, mesh repair, splitting into parts and single-color or multicolor 3MF files, or explore Creative Lab to create figurines, lamps, keychains and fridge magnets. Hand print files to your slicer and save assets directly into your project.

Requires a Meshy account; what you can generate and download depends on that account.

defaultPrompt: Create a low-poly treasure chest for my game with PBR textures.
Turn this photo into a 3D figurine I can 3D print.

positive.prompt: Make a 3D model of a red vintage alarm clock for a product render, straight from this description, with realistic textures.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts an untextured preview from the description and shows its card with progress. Once the preview succeeded, textures it with text_to_3d_refine and shows the textured model. Exactly one preview and one texturing are created.

positive.prompt: Turn this picture into a 3D model for a product render.
positive.expected_behavior: Passes the attached picture as image_file, starts one image-to-3D model and shows its card; the finished model is textured.

positive.prompt: Draw a cute robot mascot first, then turn that picture into a 3D model for a render.
positive.expected_behavior: Generates one picture and shows it. Once the picture is accepted, starts image-to-3D with one of the picture's image_urls as image_url. No extra pictures or models are created.

positive.prompt: Find my newest untextured model and give it a weathered bronze texture.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the untextured models, textures the newest one whose texturable is true with a bronze texture_prompt, and shows the textured model.

positive.prompt: Open Meshy 3D, tell me my credit balance, and give me my newest model as an FBX.
positive.expected_behavior: Opens the Meshy 3D app with the newest models, states the credit balance, and returns an FBX download link for the newest succeeded model.

negative.description: Rigging and animation need a terminal with the Meshy CLI. In ChatGPT without one, the plugin says they are not available here, installs nothing, and does not describe the model as rigged.
negative.prompt: Rig my newest model and make it walk.

negative.description: Print repair and multicolor 3MF need a terminal with the Meshy CLI. In ChatGPT without one, the plugin offers the STL download as the handoff and never calls the model printable.
negative.prompt: Repair my newest model and make a multicolor 3MF that is guaranteed to print.
Buy 1,000 Meshy credits for me and upgrade my plan.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. Generating uses credits from the user's existing Meshy account, and downloads follow that account's plan.

publication.release_notes: In hosts with a terminal, the skills now install the Meshy CLI on first use instead of calling its steps unavailable, upgrade a CLI that is too old for them, and tell you when a newer release is out. No change to the MCP server.
